name: Tabitha Bones
source:
This cynical girl has a rich inner world and a vivid imagination, with a fascination for the occult and human skeletons. 

Prone to self-doubts and victimization. 

[From [url=https://belleinpastel.itch.io/this-magical-girl-is-a-btch]Itch.io[/url]]
